dimensions.observation: Ran the frozen suite on the artifact (8/8 OK, exit 0). test_s1_s2 passed: on accept the summary carries exactly SUMMARY_KEYS including started_at and ended_at, no escalation.json written, started_at equals the first clock call spelled in the local zone, ended_at is a clock reading with started_at <= ended_at, the on-disk summary.json matches the returned summary, packet_sha256 stays the hash of the packet bytes, and the stamp does not appear in the packet raw.

dimensions.name: s3_round_stamps_fall_inside_the_job_window_in_order
dimensions.observation: test_s3 passed: a 2-round run (regenerate then accept) writes round records with exactly ROUND_KEYS, no refused_at, each round's started_at <= ended_at, each inside [summary started_at, summary ended_at], round 1 ended_at <= round 2 started_at (in order across rounds), and rounds_sha256 equals the per-file sha256 list including the new fields.

dimensions.name: s4_refusal_stamps_are_taken_before_load
dimensions.observation: test_s4 passed: with a wrapped _load the clock had already been called at least once before _load ran; no summary.json was written; the refusal escalation.json carries exactly REFUSAL_KEYS with started_at and refused_at and no ended_at; started_at equals the first clock call; refused_at is a later clock call, not a copy of started_at.

dimensions.name: s5_cap_floor_and_other_escalations_carry_the_summary_stamps
dimensions.observation: test_s5 (cap/floor) passed all three subtests: cap_reached, below_floor/rejected and maker-failed/other. In each, the summary carries exactly SUMMARY_KEYS with ended_at, the escalation.json carries exactly ESCALATION_KEYS with started_at equal to the summary's started_at, no refused_at and no ended_at on that file, summary started_at <= ended_at, and separation_gaps equal the two expected gap sentences.

dimensions.name: s5_clock_stop_with_no_rounds_still_stamps_the_summary
dimensions.observation: test_s5 (clock stop) passed: with a monotonic clock stopped after the first reading, the summary carries exactly SUMMARY_KEYS with started_at and ended_at, started_at <= ended_at, rounds = 0, no round-01.json written, and the escalation.json carries started_at equal to the summary's with no ended_at and no refused_at.

dimensions.name: s6_wall_clock_jump_does_not_change_stop_state_or_rounds
dimensions.observation: test_s6 passed: the _JumpClock (forward then backward jumps) produced exactly the same (stop, terminal_state, rounds) as the steady _SeqClock, namely ("accepted", "accepted", 1); the stamps are recorded but nothing reads them to choose a stop, state or round count, and the stamps are not clamped.
